How to use this archive

Each field runs oldest to newest. Pick a field, read down the line, and open the papers whose finding surprises you. The title opens the full paper in a new tab, usually its free arXiv page. Built on and Led to jump to the papers before and after it, sometimes in another field: the transformer came out of translation work, and diffusion moved from images into robot control.

The one-line findings are summaries, not quotes, so the paper is always the authority. Every title and link was checked against its source in October 2026. Incident reports are marked as such: they are not peer-reviewed papers.
